Only allowed write: design-proposal-report.md in clone root. Do not edit source/config or run Agentflow, delegate, commit, push, access live services, or send messages. Priority: functioning automatic evaluation first; measure expense before optimizing. Do NOT preserve previous three-file/no-model-calls restriction, cheap-tier shortcuts or human prerequisite. Do not change Agentflow settings; distinguish this planning worker's model from product evaluator choices.

No live DB/network/model execution/tests/credentials or source edits during this design.

Report sections: (1) amended observable requirements numbered E-1... with original R-13..18 mapping; (2) current source/discovery facts and new execution boundary, explicit assumptions; (3) implementable end-to-end design and normal operator journey, exact expected source/test/docs paths, outputs/states; (4) meaningful acceptance plan and remaining limits. Choose reasonable functional defaults without asking the owner to solve routine implementation details. This planning deliverable can combine the requirement amendment/source map/specification, but clearly separate their sign-offs for parent inspection before any source work.

Required functioning journey, not JSON import-only facade:
- User invokes one command with a frozen local git revision/check-out and review findings/evidence plus explicit model profiles. Tool prepares complete immutable snapshot/evidence identity, then actually dispatches two distinct model IDs in isolated fresh sessions to assess each finding (same evidence, no other judge responses and no original author's model identity). Strong configured models; prefer different families when configured, record same-family correlation when not. Never silently substitute duplicate/cheaper IDs. Stable findings may batch within one snapshot if every finding gets an explicit record; no stage omission just for savings.
- Each judge returns support/refute/insufficient-evidence, severity, usefulness, exact evidence/counterexample and references; output validation rejects invented line/file/evidence IDs. Evidence provenance says model-assessment, not human ground truth. Do not claim majority proves correctness or confidence numbers are calibrated.
- Evidence/reproduction validation actually runs relevant proposed checks in an isolated disposable environment without live credentials/service effects; retain test code/commands/results and positive/negative controls where applicable. Distinguish static evidence, executed reproduced/refuted, environment blocked, and unproven. Never execute a model-produced shell string in the orchestration host. Specify a concrete feasible executor contract and preflight, not a magical sandbox; a failed/unavailable test stays blocked/unproven, not passed. Production checkout untouched; no automatic patch/merge/review authority.
- Synthesis is a fresh model session that sees both validated independent assessments and evidence, preserves disagreement, may conclude unknown, cannot fabricate evidence or silently override failed tests. Produce per-finding final assessment with auditable chain and machine-readable output. Original evaluators do not see synthesis.
- For escape discovery, a separate model/session examines the same frozen code+diff without seeing original findings or judges, proposes candidates. Reconcile candidates with original findings after discovery, dedupe at same scope, and run independent candidate validation/reproduction before calling them automatically-supported omissions. Not human-confirmed escapes, no recall claim. Include this functioning discovery/validation stage in first delivery, not a future TODO merely to save calls.
- Weekly report automatically consumes these machine outputs, distinguishes model-supported/refuted/unresolved findings, usefulness coverage, model disagreement, actual test-validation coverage and automatically-supported omission candidates vs optional human-confirmed ground truth. No human input required to finish. Reliable/visible failure/superseded and latency stay based on real controller/GitHub evidence, separate from judging. Cost/source/usage per invocation and retries with actual-vs-unknown totals; don't invent provider price/account telemetry. No automatic skipping, caching across changed snapshot/prompt/model or token budget imposed for savings in first version.

Model transport should be a concrete project-local executor using available configured CLI/API capabilities via literal argv/structured input with exact identities, bounded response validation and durable raw result artifacts; no dependency on /Users/can paths or private installed Agentflow files in product code. If no runner in repo, admit and specify the needed module. Product model identity/config is an explicit operational input, not a hard-coded unverified model name. Define preflight for two distinct configured evaluators and synthesis/discovery/validation profiles. User already authorizes model use/cost; no further generic spend approval.

Freeze input/result schema only as needed for runnable boundary: snapshot/model/prompt/tool identities, invocation IDs, evidence IDs and line ranges, successful/partial/failed run outcomes, retries/restart without replaying completed effects, strict mismatch/conflict handling, semantic reporting. Missing capabilities/errors must be visible; cannot let all-failed stages create an apparently valid quality score. Support actual one-command live model smoke journey on a synthetic repo plus deterministic fake-runner tests; mocked tests alone are not end-to-end acceptance. Real PTY journey for CLI required later. Actual caller-provided source disclosure is bounded to that snapshot and configured model provider; never gather neighboring repo files/secrets.

No need to build fleet, live integration, dashboards, scheduler, automated deployment, or solve Stage 3 council-vs-independent experiment now. Explain functional completeness separately from later efficiency tuning. Keep plan concrete enough to implement directly and account for every added module by its user-visible role. Preserve Stage 1 approved commit d6e96c3 and all existing unrelated source. Exact new Design Go will follow the finished design; do not ask generic cost confirmation or run models now.

Report must start with a fresh Asia/Taipei timestamp in format * _YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (gpt-5.6-terra/high)_ and end with exactly one Self-check: line, nothing after it. Write the report yourself to design-proposal-report.md; final stdout may summarize.

# Stage 2 amendment and replacement design — automatic review evaluation

## Authority and two sign-offs

This is a read-only design proposal. It replaces the prior Stage 2
three-file, no-model-call/human-prerequisite design; it preserves approved Stage 1
result `d6e96c3` and all unrelated source. It authorizes no source work, model run,
network/live-service access, credential use, Agentflow action, commit, or rollout.
The planning worker model is `gpt-5.6-terra/high`; it is not a product evaluator choice.

Parent sign-off A — requirements amendment: accept E-1..E-12 below as the owner-authorized
scope, superseding only the conflicting Stage 2 portions of the prior design/resolution.
Parent sign-off B — implementation specification: after A, approve the exact paths,
contracts, controls, and acceptance plan below before any source work. A is not Design Go.

Scope discipline — implement exactly the ask; park everything else as a proposal. The ask's scope is what the user wrote plus tests, commits, the notebook, STATUS, and any records required by the active route. Do not refactor, rename, reformat, add dependencies, or repair adjacent behavior unless the Ask requires it. Pass this paragraph verbatim in every worker brief.

## Amended observable requirements

- E-1 (R-13 replacement): one invocation automatically assesses every supplied finding
  against a frozen local revision and explicit evidence; no human annotation is needed to
  finish. Its provenance is `model_assessment`, never human ground truth or correctness.
- E-2 (R-13 extension): two fresh, independently prompted evaluator sessions with distinct
  configured `model_id`s assess each finding as `support`, `refute`, or
  `insufficient_evidence`, with severity, usefulness, exact evidence/counterexample, and
  references. Strong profiles are required; prefer distinct families and record an allowed
  same-family correlation. Duplicate/cheap substitutions fail preflight, never silently run.
- E-3 (R-13 extension): validate every returned file/line range and evidence ID against the
  immutable manifest; reject invented references and mark that assessment invalid.
- E-4 (R-13 extension): a separate fresh synthesis session receives evidence plus both
  validated assessments, not evaluator identities or original-author model identity. It
  preserves disagreement, can say `unknown`, and cannot fabricate evidence or turn a failed
  check into support. Evaluators never receive synthesis output.
- E-5 (R-13 extension): a separate fresh discovery session sees the same frozen code/diff,
  but no supplied findings or judge output. It proposes scoped omission candidates; the tool
  then deduplicates/reconciles them and independently validates/reproduces them before
  labelling `automatically_supported_omission`. They are not human-confirmed escapes and make
  no recall claim. Discovery is first-delivery functionality, not a savings TODO.
- E-6 (R-13 extension): every finding/candidate has static and execution evidence state:
  `static_evidence`, `executed_reproduced`, `executed_refuted`,
  `environment_blocked`, or `unproven`. Relevant declared checks execute in a disposable,
  credential-free, no-network environment; blocked/failed checks cannot pass by inference.
- E-7 (R-14 unchanged in meaning): the weekly output derives accepted-to-terminal-projection
  latency only from existing controller/GitHub evidence, retaining unavailable/upper-bound and
  clock qualifications. Model judging is not its clock source.
- E-8 (R-15 amended): record per-invocation model/profile/source, attempts, usage supplied by
  that provider, and reconciled actual cost where supplied; otherwise state actual total is
  unknown. No price table, token budget, cache, or stage skip is introduced to save money.
- E-9 (R-16 unchanged in meaning): reliable, visible-failure, superseded, and unknown remain
  the prior source-bound controller/GitHub classifications, separate from model assessment.
- E-10 (R-17 amended): weekly Markdown/JSON automatically cons
